quotes.text: I visited the @HiddenGeniusPro and as a former STEM teacher I was very impressed. We discussed both the challenges and opportunities for young Black men in tech and entrepreneurship, especially in the era of AI. https://t.co/PeGO6BzdKy

AI has become a more prevalent part of our everyday lives. @FSCDems are working to ensure that as AI integrates into our financial and housing systems, we do everything we can to prevent bias and harm to marginalized communities. https://t.co/09VEjr4jhu

By equipping our nonprofits with essential AI skills, we’re not simply investing in technology, we’re investing in the future of our community. This initiative between Google and the Community Foundation for Greater Atlanta demonstrates the power of collaboration to better serve our residents. [...] Through Google’s generous commitment, we are empowering organizations, fostering innovation, and increasing our capacity to better serve the people right here in the Fighting Fifth.

I hosted leaders from Cox Enterprises (@coxenterprises) and Cox Automotive (@coxautomotive) to discuss the future of AI, innovation, and Georgia's workforce.
 
As technology continues to evolve, we must ensure innovation doesn't come at the expense of workers. With more than 900 Cox employees living and working in the #FightingFifth, these conversations help ensure technological progress creates opportunity without leaving people behind.

From talking about building generational wealth and protecting travelers to encouraging the next generation of innovators and discussing leadership in the age of AI, it was another busy week delivering for the #FightingFifth.  
Catch up on it all in this week’s #NikemasNotes! https://t.co/U626vk9uCK

The #FightingFifth is home to some of the most influential talent in music, so I loved meeting with the Atlanta Chapter of the Recording Academy.

We had a thoughtful conversation about the emerging role of AI in the music industry and what it means for creators. I always want to hear from those shaping Atlanta’s music community and bring their voices to Congress.
